hook.name: StockHook
hook.description: Fixed-fee hook for a single STONKCOIN/NVDA pool. Charges immutable BUY_FEE_BPS on buys and SELL_FEE_BPS on sells (always in NVDA), collected via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and minted as ERC-6909 claims to a FeeRouter. Maintains a TWAP oracle and restricts pool initialization to a Genesis contract; early liquidity additions are limited to an LP vault until genesis closes.
